This Criminal Petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, is filed seeking return of the tobacco products that were seized from the possession of the petitioners in Crime No.211 of 2020 of Tenali I Town Police Station of Guntur District.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
3. The F.I.R. registered against the petitioners in Crime No.211 of 2020 of Tenali I Town Police Station of Guntur District, for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 420, 272, 273 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 56, 57(1) and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act,

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
3. The F.I.R. registered against the petitioners in Crime No.211 of 2020 of Tenali I Town Police Station of Guntur District, for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 420, 272, 273 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 56, 57(1) and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006, was quashed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.4729 of 2020 as per order dated 22-10-2020.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Therefore, the petitioners are entitled for return of the tobacco products that were seized from their possession in connection with the above crime.
4. In the result, this Criminal Petition is allowed.
The Station House Officer of Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District, is hereby directed to return the tobacco products that were seized from the possession of the petitioners in the above crime, to the petitioners on proper identification and acknowledgment.
Miscellaneous Petitions, if any pending, in this Criminal Petition, shall stand closed.
